summary: Frontend-only testing of deep-dive reader (per-chapter snap) and Explore tile rename. On 360x720 all checks pass: chapter 1 aligned perfectly (scrollTop=703, offsetTop=759, delta=56), every chapter offsetHeight=656 (winH-64), wheel steps advance exactly one chapter with counter 01/06->06/06 and reach the ending page, wheel back reverses one chapter per tick, previews compact with fontSize=12<=14, no big watermark inside previews, ch6 has no preview, no text cut-off (all bodyBottom < previewTop, min gap 19px), no page errors, only warnings are RN Web deprecations (textShadow*, pointerEvents prop, reanimated easing). Explore tile shows 'EXPLORE' + 'Every category is a discovery' and aria-checked toggles correctly. On 390x844 the initial chapter-1 snap after start=1 lands at scrollTop=821 while expected=788 (offsetTop 844 - 56) => off by 33px (out of the ±3 tolerance); however wheel-forward/back still snap each subsequent chapter exactly to offsetTop-56 (ch2..ch6 verified) and counter advances 01->06 correctly. DOM analysis on 390x844 also reported a 2nd chapter's big watermark number peeking ~57px inside the viewport at the initial position (rect.top~787 with winH=844) because chapter 1 sits 33px too high; visually the screenshot doesn't show a duplicated big number, but this is a direct consequence of the 33px misalignment on the taller viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: On viewport 390x844 with clean state, opening /deep-dive/sky-blue-sunset-orange?start=1 initially scrolls to scrollTop=821 while the expected target is 788 (offsetTop(chapter-1) 844 - 56). Off by 33px (>±3 tolerance). All wheel-step targets afterwards are correct (ch2..ch6 all hit offsetTop-56 exactly). On 360x720 the same flow is perfectly aligned (703 == 703). Suggests the initial jumpTo(1) fires while topsRef[0] is still 33px higher than the final measured value on 844-tall viewport (likely a re-measure after intro grows) and touchedRef/lastJumpRef branch does not re-snap correctly on that viewport.

As a direct side effect of the 33px misalignment on 390x844, the DOM check reports reader-chapter-number-2 with getBoundingClientRect().top ~787 inside a 844-tall viewport at the initial position (i.e. ~57px of chapter-2's big '02' watermark sits inside the visible window below the chapter-1 preview). Not visible in the screenshot (likely occluded by preview overlay/gradient) but confirms chapter 1 is not aligned to the top gutter as intended.

action_items: Investigate the initial chapter-1 snap on tall viewports (390x844): once topsRef changes after intro measurement completes, ensure the fallback re-snap in recomputeTops (`else if (!pending && !touchedRef.current && lastJumpRef.current > 0) jumpTo(...)`) actually fires. Currently the on-390x844 final scrollTop is 821 instead of expected 788 (offsetTop 844 - headerBottom 64 + spacing.sm 8 = 788). Same code path is correct on 360x720. Possible causes: touchedRef flipped by the wheel handler or the pan gesture during layout, or lastJumpRef reset, or an early jump using stale coverTop/introH that never triggers the else branch because prev tops already equals new tops (tops.every equality short-circuit before re-snap).
Migrate deprecated textShadow* style props in category-grid.tsx (allName/allSub) to the new textShadow object style.
Move `pointerEvents` from prop to style in reader-section.tsx (bigNumber, divider) and any other View using props.pointerEvents.
Replace Easing.out(Easing.cubic) in category-grid staggered FadeInUp entry with an easing supported on web (or gate by Platform.OS) to silence the reanimated warning.
critical_code_review_comments: recomputeTops re-snap condition (deep-dive/[id].tsx L200) short-circuits with early return when `tops.length === prev.length && tops.every equal` — if the very first tops publication already matches the (stale) initial ones after a later intro re-measure, the re-snap never runs. Consider always re-snapping when !touchedRef.current && lastJumpRef.current > 0 && current scrollTop diverges from the recomputed target by more than a small tolerance.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all functional requirements pass on 360x720; initial ch1 snap misaligned by 33px on 390x844)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduce on viewport 390x844 with a clean localStorage/sessionStorage: navigate to /deep-dive/sky-blue-sunset-orange?start=1, wait >=6s, then read `document.querySelector('[data-testid="deep-dive-scroll"]').scrollTop` and compare to `offsetTop(deep-dive-page-chapter-1) - 56`. Expected 788, observed 821 (delta 33). Same test on 360x720 returns 703 == 703 (aligned). Wheel forward/back navigation itself works correctly and each subsequent chapter aligns exactly.
rca_of_issue: On 844-tall viewport the initial scrollToSection(1) fires from the `start=1` useEffect via requestAnimationFrame. At that moment topsRef[0] is computed from coverTop+introH. Intro likely grows a bit after the first onLayout (fonts settling, later paint) which changes introH by ~33px. The `else if (!touchedRef.current && lastJumpRef.current > 0) jumpTo(lastJumpRef.current, false)` re-snap only runs when tops actually change AND the pending branch didn't already consume it. If topsRef changes but the intro-driven change happens between two recomputeTops calls where the tops tuple's equality check already matches the previous tuple (because the height increment propagated inside a single call), no re-snap happens. On 360x720 introH stabilises before the initial jump; on 844 there's an extra measurement pass.
